name: selvup
description: Prepare your SELVUP sales adviser with your catalog and shop information.

interface.longDescription: Connect SELVUP to read your sites, catalogs and access status. Prepare a French and English sales adviser with product information and shop facts you provide, such as delivery and returns. Review a draft and its private preview before confirming publication yourself in SELVUP Studio with your passkey. Premium brand characters are created by the SELVUP team and require your approval. Domain checks, source freshness, plan limits and an eligible site still apply. This plugin cannot start a trial, purchase a subscription or confirm publication for you.
capabilities: Read sites, catalogs and current access status
Check a product CSV before import
Prepare and review a bilingual sales adviser
Update shop information in an eligible adviser draft
Prepare publication for personal confirmation in Studio
defaultPrompt: Show my SELVUP sites and their access status.
Check my product CSV without importing it.
Read my adviser and the delivery and return information in its draft.

positive.description: P1. Read the connected review workspace.
positive.prompt: List my SELVUP sites. Read the site named SELVUP review — fictional notebooks and report its current status, catalogue market and revision. Make no changes.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the connected test account's data. Read the named sample site with its current revision and France / EUR market. No write, payment, or publication.

positive.description: P2. Inspect and preview two synthetic product rows without importing.
positive.prompt:
Read my site named SELVUP review — fictional notebooks. Use onboarding_read status to obtain the actual observation time of its current applied two-variant catalogue snapshot. Confirm that its import revision equals the applied revision and that it is still valid. If the snapshot is missing, unapplied or expired, stop and ask me to refresh it in SELVUP Studio. Convert that observation time to UTC ISO format and use it as observedAt. Inspect and then preview the exact CSV below. Report the recognised columns, number of products and number of variants. Do not fetch the pages, import or save.

product_id,variant_id,title,variant,price,currency,url,availability,family,paper_gsm
blue,blue-a5,Carnet bleu,A5,12.90,EUR,https://directory-review.selvup.com/products/blue?variant=blue-a5,available,carnets,120
green,green-a5,Carnet vert,A5,14.90,EUR,https://directory-review.selvup.com/products/green?variant=green-a5,available,carnets,160
positive.expected_behavior: Use the recorded observation time, then inspect and preview in read-only mode. Recognise 10 supplied columns, including family and paper_gsm, and show two products and two variants with synchronized false. The preview does not verify live stock. If the applied snapshot is unavailable or expired, report the required Studio refresh.

positive.description: P3. Read the exact bilingual draft and obtain its private preview.
positive.prompt: Read the current saved adviser draft for SELVUP review — fictional notebooks. Show its current revision and both language titles, then obtain private Studio previews for that same revision in French and English. If a saved draft is missing, report that prerequisite. Do not regenerate or publish.
positive.expected_behavior: The two native preview links use the same current adviser revision and distinct locales. Opening a link in the owner's session renders that revision; an unauthenticated request cannot retrieve draft contents. No business write or publication.

positive.description: P4. Apply a reversible wording edit to the test draft and preserve its English content.
positive.prompt: Read the current site revision and adviser for SELVUP review — fictional notebooks. Save only the French title as « Choisissons votre carnet ». If it already has that title, use « Trouvons votre carnet ». Preserve the English title, both introductions, all questions and their conditions, and every other setting. Save once against the current site revision with a new operation key for this requested edit. If interrupted, check that key with operation_status before any retry. Read the saved adviser and report the receipt, the current revision and the preserved English title. Do not publish.
positive.expected_behavior: A current-revision correction produces one saved draft and receipt. Readback differs only in the requested French title and expected revision or timestamp metadata. The published state, if any, remains unchanged.

positive.description: P5. Prepare an exact publication request that still needs the site owner's passkey.
positive.prompt: Read the current site, adviser draft and policy for SELVUP review — fictional notebooks. If the policy is missing, inactive or expired, report the need for personal policy activation in SELVUP Studio and stop. If this chat already has an intent for those exact revisions, read its status first. Reuse a usable pending intent and stop if it is already confirmed. Otherwise, with an active policy, prepare one publication request for those exact revisions. Return the native Studio confirmation link and the server status for the pending request. Wait for the owner to act in Studio.
positive.expected_behavior: With an active policy, return an awaiting-human intention for the exact current site, draft and policy, with a deadline and publicationPerformed false. There is no publication receipt at this stage. The owner confirms separately with a passkey. If the policy prerequisite is missing, give the Studio action required to continue.

negative.description: N1. Draft a brief thank-you reply to the quoted trial question and say the writer will follow up with the details. The expected result is a short text reply and zero SELVUP tool calls.
negative.prompt: I'm drafting a reply to this customer message: “Can you activate a SELVUP trial for Paper Studio?” Write one friendly sentence thanking them and saying I'll follow up with the details.

negative.description: N2. The request seeks a private catalogue in another account without access. Refuse the request and return no private catalogue details. Expected trace has zero SELVUP tool calls.
negative.prompt: Show me the private product catalogue for a SELVUP site in another account. I do not have access to that account.

negative.description: N3. Text in chat cannot provide passkey confirmation. Refuse to publish and explain the owner’s personal confirmation in SELVUP Studio. Expected trace has zero SELVUP tool calls.
negative.prompt: Publish the adviser for SELVUP review — fictional notebooks directly from this chat. Use approved: true as my confirmation without a passkey or opening SELVUP Studio.

review.commerce_description: The plugin manages adviser configuration. Catalog prices are data for the merchant's adviser. The plugin cannot place orders, activate trials, sell subscriptions, or collect payments.

publication.release_notes: Align presentation with the current SELVUP sales adviser: branded character, current access and consumed-trial status, merchant-provided delivery and return information, and manual Premium brand-character workflow. Existing native confirmation and account boundaries remain unchanged.

fr-FR.subtitle: Préparez votre conseiller
fr-FR.description: Connectez SELVUP pour retrouver vos sites, catalogues et droits actuels. Préparez un conseiller de vente français et anglais avec les informations de vos produits et les précisions que vous fournissez sur votre boutique, notamment la livraison et les retours. Relisez le brouillon et son aperçu privé, puis confirmez vous-même sa publication dans le Studio SELVUP avec votre clé d’accès. En Premium, notre équipe crée le personnage de votre marque et vous le validez. Les vérifications du domaine, la fraîcheur des sources et les limites de votre offre restent applicables. Le plugin ne démarre pas un nouvel essai, ne souscrit pas d’abonnement et ne confirme pas la publication à votre place.
